reviewNotes: All 77 unique supplied photographs visually reviewed in a contact sheet. No sufficiently aligned, documented before-and-after pair was identified.
Existing homepage comparison shows different roof close-ups and is not reused as a genuine project pair.
Each selected asset has two matching square panels: before at left, after at right. These are illustrations, not client project evidence.
Related service and location pages may share a relevant service example; no local project or performance claim is inferred.
The remaining 26 legacy gallery photographs were also visually reviewed; they contain finished views, installation details and reference images, without a suitable aligned before-and-after sequence.
